title: EmoTra-TTS: Smooth Intra-Utterance Emotion Transitions for Speech Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.23791v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Psychological research on emotion dynamics has established that human affect is a continuous, evolving process: emotions rise, decay, and transition within seconds. Current emotional text-to-speech (TTS) systems, however, condition on a single discrete label or static embedding per utterance, fundamentally misaligning with the temporal nature of affect. While recent LLM-based TTS systems may implicitly vary prosody through text understanding, such variation is neither explicitly controllable nor precise enough for targeted intra-utterance transitions. translated_title: EmoTra-TTS：语音合成中的平滑句内情感转换
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23791v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：关于情绪动态的心理学研究已确立，人类情感是一个连续、演变的过程：情绪在数秒内上升、衰减和转换。然而，当前的情感文本到语音（TTS）系统仅依赖每个话语的单一离散标签或静态嵌入进行条件设定，从根本上与情感的时间性不符。尽管基于LLM的近期TTS系统可能通过文本理解隐含地变化韵律，但这种变化既不可显式控制，也不足以精确实现目标性的句内转换。我们解决了三个挑战：（1）一种多通流混合管线合成帧对齐的转换音频，规避了自然句内转换数据的稀缺性；（2）双阶段效价-唤醒-支配（VAD）条件设定通过帧级VAD嵌入指导LLM中的韵律规划和流解码器中的声学实现；（3）方向和幅度解耦注入...
tldr: 本论文提出EmoTra-TTS，通过多通流混合管线合成帧对齐音频、双阶段VAD条件设定和方向-幅度解耦注入，实现了可精确控制的句内情感平滑转换，克服了自然数据稀缺和静态情感条件设定的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EmoTra-TTS, which achieves precisely controllable smooth intra-utterance emotion transitions via a multi-pass flow blending pipeline, dual-stage VAD conditioning, and direction-magnitude decoupled injection, overcoming natural data scarcity and static emotion conditioning limitations.
